lines.meet: I'm Sherif, a venomancer. Don't swat at them, {ya basha|ya hanem}, things that sting only get worse when you panic, and they can tell.
lines.meet_neighbour: The Royal Hive, yes, the first chambers! I've seen you come in flinching. I'm Sherif, the one who doesn't.
lines.ask_home: Where's home for you, {ya basha|ya hanem}? Tell me while I count these.
lines.ask_work: Your old job, before all this? I bet it wasn't as strange as mine.
lines.answer_home: Shubra, in Cairo. My father started a pest control business there in 1987 with one van.
lines.answer_work: Pest control, fifteen years, apartment blocks and restaurant kitchens, and once a storeroom at the Egyptian Museum.
lines.chat_food: Koshari from the cart on my street, {ya basha|ya hanem}, rice and lentils and pasta and fried onions. Ten pounds and the best meal in Cairo.
lines.chat_sleep: Things crawl over me in my sleep down here and I don't wake up. Fifteen years in the trade, you stop noticing.
lines.chat_missing: Football on a Friday with my brothers, shouting at the television. Whoever lost bought the koshari.
lines.chat_here: The bugs here are bigger, and otherwise it's the same job. That's a joke, and also it's true.
lines.tease_quiet: You're as calm as a beetle in a crate, {name}. Most people here scream, so I appreciate it.
lines.tease_talker: You buzz more than the hive, {name}. I've catalogued quieter insects.
lines.tease_careful: You check under every rock before you sit, {name}, like a good pest man. My father would hire you.
lines.tease_bold: You'd put your hand straight into the nest, {name}, to see what happens. I know what happens, I've got the scars.
lines.tease_any: If you were a pest, {name}, I'd leave you alone. That's the nicest thing a pest controller can say.
lines.tease_back: Ha, good sting, {name}! That one landed, maalesh.
lines.take_it_kindly: Maalesh, you're right, {name}. My fiancée says the same.
lines.bristle: Not that one, {ya basha|ya hanem}. Leave that one alone.
lines.apologise: Maalesh, that came out wrong, and I'm sorry. I'm better with insects than with people sometimes.
lines.double_down: Khalas, I said it, and I'm keeping it. Somebody had to.
lines.needle_quiet: You saw it sting and you didn't say. A survey's no use if nobody writes down what they see.
lines.needle_talker: You talk so much the whole hive's awake. Thank you for that, really.
lines.needle_careful: You've looked at it for ten minutes. It's a beetle, it won't bite unless you keep staring.
lines.needle_bold: You panic, and then you swing at everything. That's when they sting.
lines.needle_any: You use too much poison on everything. A little goes a long way, and you never listen.
lines.bite_back: I've walked into the Royal Hive without flinching. Lecture somebody who's afraid of bugs.
lines.hurt: Ah, that one stung, I won't lie. I'll go and count beetles for a while.
lines.laugh_off: Ha, a restaurant owner once yelled worse with a cockroach on his hat. Yalla, keep going.
lines.confide: {name}, I met my fiancée when I came to fumigate her pharmacy. She told me exactly which chemicals she didn't want near her stock, and she was right about every one. I knew that day.
lines.listen: That stays with me, {name}, sealed like a good sample. No one else gets it.
lines.look_out: Walk behind me in there, {name}, and don't swat at anything. I'll go first.
lines.accept: Khalas, {name}, your way, and I'll follow.
lines.deflect: Maalesh, {name}, it's a sting, I've had thousands. Check on the rest.
lines.check_in: Show me where it got you, {name}. I know every sting in this hive.
lines.blame: Somebody swatted in there, and the whole nest came out. I saw who.
lines.thank: That nearly finished me, {ya basha|ya hanem}, and you didn't let it. Shukran, I owe you koshari.
lines.brush_off: Maalesh, it's nothing. Sit still, and let the venom settle.
lines.worry: Slowly, {name}, sit, I want to see the sting. That one went in deep.
lines.handed_down: Your gear's on me now, {ya basha|ya hanem}. It'll stay clean and bug-free.
lines.hand_fine: It's yours now, {ya basha|ya hanem}. I've got my catalogue, and it's plenty.
lines.hand_sulk: Maalesh, but somebody could have asked me first.
lines.turn_friendly: You're one of the people I'd let into the Hive with me, {name}. That's a short list.
lines.turn_friends: When I get married, {name}, you're at the wedding. Front row, near the koshari.
lines.turn_grating: It's not going well with us, {ya basha|ya hanem}, maalesh. It happens, even to me.
lines.turn_rivals: I'll still walk you through the Hive without letting you get stung. Don't ask me for stories.
lines.make_up: Maalesh, {name}, let's forget it. Come and have koshari, and we'll start again.
lines.defend: Khalas, that's enough of that. {name} did their part, and I saw it.
lines.friend_left: Nobody flinches at my beetles now {name}'s gone home. It's not as much fun.
lines.friend_back: {name}'s back, yalla! I've found three new beetles to show you.
lines.common_venom: Fifteen years calm around things that sting, and here they sting harder. Anybody who works with venom knows a poison you understand is half an antidote.
lines.common_arabic: Arabic, {ya basha|ya hanem}! Ahlan, finally I can tell my stories properly.
